summary: Frontend-only static mockup for Hey Pop Chips tested end-to-end. All 11 public pages + 2 admin pages + partials + static assets return HTTP 200. Hero, sticky header (with glassmorphism on scroll), mobile drawer, product filters, Leaflet maps with markers, store/vending filters & search, contact form (localStorage), FAQ accordion, newsletter, admin login + dashboard tab switching, and logout all work. No literal Unicode escape strings (\u201C / \u2014 / \u2019) detected in any rendered page. One minor inconsistency: 404.html does NOT include the shared footer (no data-include='footer' placeholder).

ui_bugs.issue: 404.html is missing both the shared header and footer partial placeholders (data-include='header'/'footer'). Spec states 'Footer renders on every page'. Other public pages include both.

action_items:
Add
at top of and
before closing in /app/frontend/public/404.html (and ensure /js/main.js is loaded) so the branded header/footer render consistently with the rest of the site.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact form: All required fields enforced correctly via HTML5; success status auto-clears after 6s (works as designed).

Admin auth is correctly sessionStorage-mocked (hpc_admin flag). dashboard.html guards by redirecting to /admin/index.html if flag missing. Suitable as a mock; flag this as MOCKED for PHP backend handover.
Multiple inline <script> blocks on each page (store-locator, vending, contact) contain duplicate Leaflet boilerplate. Consider extracting a shared /js/maps.js for maintainability, but not blocking.
Newsletter form is a true no-op (only success toast). Confirmed by spec — acceptable.
All interactive elements correctly use data-testid attributes which made testing reliable.
test_credentials: Admin (mock): admin@heypopchips.com / popadmin (prefilled in /admin/index.html, sessionStorage based).
seed_data_creation: None. Contact form writes to localStorage.hpc_contacts on submit (verified, 151 bytes after one submission).
context_for_next_testing_agent: This is a static HTML/CSS/JS mockup served from /app/frontend/public/. React entry is intentionally empty. No backend. All flows tested: home/about/products/product-detail/store-locator/available-online/vending-machines/social/contact/404 + /admin/index.html and /admin/dashboard.html. Maps use Leaflet/OpenStreetMap. The contact form requires Subject (select) in addition to name/email/message — test scripts must select_option on [data-testid='contact-subject'] before submit. FAQ uses native <details><summary>, so no aria-expanded — check 'open' attribute instead. Admin dashboard renders all section panels in DOM and toggles visibility via JS (so locator counts may include hidden tables — filter by :visible).

404_missing_footer.reproduction: GET /404.html and inspect DOM — no <footer> element and no [data-include='footer'] placeholder.
404_missing_footer.root_cause: 404.html was authored as a standalone branded page without including the partial-loader placeholders that /js/main.js fetches at runtime.
404_missing_footer.mitigation: Add the two data-include divs (header + footer) and ensure /js/main.js is loaded; the existing partial-loader in main.js will inject them automatically.
